asked: # Build: amberx-open-any-url ## Brett said (verbatim) "We need a plugin that will let AmberX open up any website I tell her to." (Context: amberx.open_url refused www.hostinger.com: "open_url only opens Brett's own sites (amberxai.com)".) 1. amberx.open_url (axHub device service) opens any http/https URL on Brett's paired phone, not only amberxai.com. Block non-http(s) schemes (intent:, file:, javascript:). Audit-log every open. 2. Setting in axHub (owner-only): mode = own sites only / allowlist / any site (default: any site, per Brett). Allowlist editable. 3. AmberX app: opens external sites in the phone's default browser; own sites keep opening in AmberX. 4. Tests, docs (decisions), PR to the merge queue. Do NOT land directly. If the AmberX APK needs a change, note it for an AmberX-AXF follow-up. One session, lean chain. Watch live: Brett can watch the screen you are changing hot-render in the console. Whenever you start work on a screen or element, run `node framework/cli/axf.mjs focus <app> [route] [css-selector] --note "<what you are changing>"` (apps: console-web, axhub-web, amberx-droid, walkthrough-studio, demo, framework, console, axhub-android, voicevault). Agent cap: heavy steps (pnpm/npm/vite builds, docker node:22 test runs, Playwright) share a VPS-wide lock. Run each one as `node /opt/axf/deploy/../framework/cli/agent-slots.mjs heavy -- <command>` so only a few run at once. Model switches: a downgrade (e.g. Fable → Opus) is fine. Fable upgrades need no approval right now (Brett, Nov 4 2026: "If it needs Fable, set it to be Fable"): a step that needs Fable (schemas, asset types, contracts, engines/kernel, cross-app protocols) is set to Fable and runs on Fable; the switch is recorded on the build. Never launch a step on a higher model than it is pinned to: raise the step first.

result.summary: amberx.open_url opens any http/https site (default), owner setting own/allowlist/any, every open logged; PR #39. APK + AXHub web screen are an AmberX-AXF follow-up.
